In this episode, Vinamre and Varun discuss:
• Why AI kills some jobs and spares others — the Mona Lisa printer test, why an M.F. Husain original goes for ₹40 crore while the print sells for ₹500, and the line between “utility” work and “preference” work
• Building Unleash the Avatar — scanning the town of Chanderi at dawn for one of the world’s largest photogrammetry libraries, Johnny Yong Bosch (Ichigo, Dante) voicing Vikram, and why the combat system was hand-coded
